# Handoff template

```text
Task / packet / worker:
Current authorization and remaining exclusions:
Revision, branch and relevant dirty/staged paths (no fabricated SHA):
Delivered paths/artifacts; accepted interface/schema revision:
Requirements/scenarios/gates covered:
Checks actually run (command, environment, result, artifact):
Review findings fixed / unresolved:
Mocks/substitutions and what evidence does not prove:
Dependency consumers affected / integration checks still needed:
Blocked input and exact unblock condition, if any:
Next safe command or action, with expected outcome:
Task board/detail updated; publication/deployment not implied:
```
